verdict.rationale: Rippling's identity page says its federated identity handles LDAP, Active Directory, OIDC and RADIUS alongside SCIM and SAML. That points to legacy-protocol support, but it is one marketing sentence. Nothing shows that Rippling actually hosts cloud LDAP or RADIUS endpoints, or that they work with VPNs, Wi-Fi or older systems. Missing for 10: documentation of hosted cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints, VPN and Wi-Fi (802.1X) setup guidance, details for legacy systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
